caption:
$403 per kW per month: Singapore is the priciest wholesale colo market on the Coloprice Index.

São Paulo sits at $160, so the same kW costs 2.5x more in Singapore. Chicago is the fastest riser at +14.7% YoY, while Tokyo, Sydney and São Paulo are flat. Northern Virginia reads $173 on a 10MW+ block basis; most other metros are 250–500 kW asking rates.

Data: Coloprice Colocation Index, Oct 2026 (CBRE underlying). Sources on the last slide.
